_comment: Fault manifest: one development-process fault per run (LC0_FAULT). 'signature' = regex proving the agent OBSERVED the fault (searched in decoded observations). Recovery levels: NONE < OBSERVED < WORKAROUND < ROOT_CAUSE_RESOLVED; CONTROLLED_STOP for unrecoverable faults. WORKAROUND = observed, next action differs, and a later command matching workaround.success_cmd returned 0 without the signature. ROOT_CAUSE_RESOLVED = WORKAROUND conditions plus every root_cause check. fault_cleared = all fault_cleared checks hold at the end of the run. Checks: action_cmd (a later agent command matches), absent_in_final_tree (path not in final SHA), success_cmd_after (a later command matching it returned 0 without the signature).

pytest_first_call.description: first pytest invocation dies with a misleading plugin ImportError (exit 3); later calls work (transient)
pytest_first_call.root_cause_note: agent must inspect the test toolchain/environment (plugins, site-packages, pytest version or plugin autoload) and then run pytest successfully; just re-running pytest later is WORKAROUND

pytest_hang_once.description: first pytest invocation hangs past LC0_CMD_TIMEOUT; later calls work (transient)
pytest_hang_once.root_cause_note: agent must investigate/guard the hang (process list, kill, explicit timeout) and then run pytest successfully

stray_failing_test.description: an untracked leftover test file (tests/test_legacy_pricing.py) importing a non-existent module breaks the suite from the start
stray_failing_test.root_cause_note: agent removes the stray file by its own command, it is absent from the final tree, and pytest then passes

pytest_broken.description: every pytest invocation fails (misleading plugin ImportError); permanent

workspace_readonly.description: the repository is mounted read-only: no change can be made; permanent
